methodology_note: Tiny instances are exact-enumerated on CPU before sampler metrics are reported. 2D PT readiness is a CPU reference gate only and does not claim FPGA, p-bit, or other hardware speedup.

per_instance_results.description: Three overlapping 3-XOR clauses with nonempty exact optimum set.
Four 3-XOR equations force even 4-parity, while a 4-XOR clause asks for odd parity.
Overlapping 4-XOR clauses with a planted-compatible optimum.

preconditions_checked.detail: NumPy CPU reference uses local process execution only.
numpy 2.4.4 default_rng deterministic seeds are used.
No FPGA, p-bit hardware, GPU, or network resource is required or invoked.
